equipment_type: Kitchen hood exhaust and supply fan controls
applies_to: Greenheck Kitchen Controls panels (standard and advanced) for kitchen hoods: up to 8 exhaust fans, 4 supply fans, 8 zones and 16 hood control boards.
summary: Greenheck Kitchen Controls (GKC) run kitchen hood exhaust and supply fans, hood lights, hood wash and temperature or optic-based demand control. The main board talks BACnet MS/TP directly on J23; BACnet IP panels get a Modbus RTU to BACnet IP gateway. The list covers room, hood and supply temperatures, optic opacity, fan VFD data, zone and fan commands, hood light and wash commands, tuning values and packed status/fault words.
notes: The list has objects for the full capacity (8 zones, 8 exhaust fans, 4 supply fans, 16 hood control boards); map only what the panel has.

Instances 0-11 (zone status, VFD fault, relay status and fault words) are BitString Value objects (BACnet type 39) on BACnet MS/TP; through the BACnet IP gateway the guide says they are Analog Values. The site has no BitString type, so they are listed as Other. Bit order is reversed between the two (bit 0 left-most on MS/TP, right-most over IP).
Access is from the R / R/W column of the BACnet points list.

source.title: Kitchen Controls Installation, Operation and Maintenance Manual - BACnet Points List

integration.summary: Turn zone fans on and off with BV 0-7 (Fans - Zone n) and hood lights with BV 8-24. Read hood and room temperatures (AI 0-8 and the HCB AIs), fan VFD frequency, and the Faults word (instance 11) for alarms. Hood wash can be started per hood control board with BV 38-53.

minimum_points.name: Faults

integration.enable: BV 0-7 turn zone fans on and off from the BMS. Each zone status word has a 'fan on via BMS' bit, so the BMS can see when its command is holding the fans on.
setup: BACnet MS/TP: default Device Instance 77000, MAC 0, Max Master 127, Max Info Frames 20; baud 9600-115200 (default 9600). Set under BMS Settings.
BACnet IP panels use a ProSoft Modbus RTU to BACnet IP QuickServer gateway; leave the main board at Modbus address 1 and 9600 baud. The gateway default IP is 192.168.2.101.
Wire BACnet MS/TP to the main board J23 terminals with shielded twisted pair.
gotchas: Status and fault words must be unpacked bit by bit, and the bit order on MS/TP is the reverse of the IP gateway.
